entries.title: Reporting Compact
entries.relationship: MQ-AICIR event states distinguish hazards, near misses, boundary violations, incidents, and serious/systemic incidents for incident-learning workflows.

entries.title: Evidence Preservation
entries.relationship: MQ-AICIR evidence, timeline, identity, control, and containment records support the proposed preservation scope.

entries.title: Review Framework
entries.relationship: MQ-AICIR root causes, boundaries, authority, control performance, and observability can record failures across the proposed operating stack.

entries.title: Notification Timelines
entries.relationship: MQ-AICIR records notification assessments but does not calculate a SAFE, contractual, or legal deadline.

entries.title: From Lessons to Controls
entries.relationship: MQ-AICIR findings, corrective actions, owners, verification evidence, and revalidation support incident-driven improvement.
